core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Orxan corresponds to the Turkic form أُورْخَان (Turkic or (place) + khan (lord)). Its core sense is orxan; khan of the place (turkic). Orxan is a Turkic (Azerbaijani) male given name, from or + khan ('lord').
